items.content_html: Wondering about the effect of AI slopification’s effect on trust. New restaurant opened with full AI branding, food photos and ads. Couldn’t bring myself to even try this - they’ve lost my trust from the outset to be anything good.
A fitting send off for Uncle Paul. A lot of stories shared and a lot of love on show at Wisos. One his friend’s son commemorated the event in paint on the wall near MacCabe Park.

items.content_html: Flying to Sydney, then driving down to Wollongong. Here to celebrate my uncles life and reconnect with the family.

items.content_html: Apparently it was ride to work day - didn’t know but still rode to work, and home again.

items.content_html: My uncle passed away on Friday quite suddenly, but for understandable health related reasons. I got through the weekend OK, making peace with his passing as natural and normal. But grief isn’t like that and it’s bitten in hard today.
